name: Spire Plus
author: wenhuorongbing-netizen
description: Spire Plus is a single gameplay-expansion mod for Slay the Spire 2. It makes high-risk choices easier to read: Ancient rewards become visible relics, A11-A20 adds Blight Sprouts, Rootblight, Firemarked Elites, Banner Rooms, boss dedicated abilities, and Branded Form, and preview tools clarify Crystal Sphere and card transforms. Requires BaseLib. 中文：Spire Plus 是《杀戮尖塔 2》的单一玩法扩展 mod。它把高风险选择讲清楚：先古之民奖励会变成可查看的遗物，A11-A20 加入根芽、根蚀、火印精英、战旗房、首领专属能力和烙印形态，并内置水晶球预知与变换预览。需要 BaseLib。
